title: High-Dimensional Statistics: Reflections on Progress and Open Problems
summary: Over the past two decades, the field of high-dimensional statistics has experienced substantial progress, driven largely by technological advances that have dramatically reduced the cost and effort for data collection and storage across a broad range of domains, including biology, medicine, astronomy, and the social and environmental sciences. Modern datasets are increasingly complex, often exhibiting rich dependency, heterogeneity, and other features that challenge traditional statistical methods.
